root_cause.text: The cpuc->events[hwc->idx] pointer assignment was placed after the PERF_HES_ARCH check in x86_pmu_enable(), so events with the ARCH flag (indicating they need counter reassignment while throttled) were skipped, leaving events[] NULL even though they later get started via the unthrottle path (which sets active_mask but does not set events[]), causing a NULL pointer dereference in the NMI handler when it iterates active counters.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message explicitly states: "Move the cpuc->events[hwc->idx] assignment in x86_pmu_enable() to before the PERF_HES_ARCH check, so that events[] is populated even for events that are not immediately started." The patch diff shows moving the assignment line above the PERF_HES_ARCH check. The CVE description provides the detailed race sequence demonstrating that events[2] was never populated while active_mask had bit 2 set, leading to the NULL dereference in x86_perf_event_update.
